selection.best_description: Triggers when a user asks to create, define, refine, update, delete, or doctor an ideal customer profile file in a connected GTM workspace, including choosing which organization owns it. Not for personas or for creating, importing, deleting, or repairing the workspace repository itself.
selection.reason: Candidates 0, 2, and 3 tied at 20/20 overall and 8/8 held-out; candidate 0 wins the non-regression and lowest-context tie-break. Candidate 1 missed the held-out read-only audit phrasing.
